title: 36 Hours in Oslo
abstract: The Norwegian capital is filled with art and stunning architecture, but nature, too, is an integral part of urban life.

title: 36 Hours in Bucharest
abstract: Rebounding from decades of repression, Romania’s capital is brimming with Italian-style cafes, museums, parks and restaurants that celebrate the country’s rich cuisine.

title: 36 Hours in Denver
abstract: A weekend in the Mile High City offers something for everyone: a flourishing restaurant scene, microbreweries, miles of trails for skiers and bikers alike, and a vibrant street art movement.

title: 36 Hours in Rome
abstract: With a bit of planning, the Eternal City can be at its most bewitching at the onset of winter.

title: 36 Hours in Jaipur
abstract: In India’s Pink City, the streets are filled with palaces, temples and, sometimes, cows. Eat like royalty, shop for jewelry and find a weekend’s worth of bliss amid the commotion.
